name: Felice Nazzaro
features: olive skin, dark hair, dark eyes, thick mustache, stocky build, strong features, commanding presence
bio: Felice Nazzaro was one of the greatest Italian racing drivers of the early automotive era. He won the French Grand Prix, the Targa Florio, and the Kaiserpreis, all in 1907. He later drove for Fiat in the 1920s Grand Prix series.
